policy: Planned categories are not exhaustive; no baseline feature may be removed. Read/create/edit/preserve are tracked separately. Resource/API utilities use read as a checkpoint grouping, not a file feature preservation claim.

items.description: Numeric access-pattern mode selection, effective availability/budget controls, bounded row sampling, actual-allocation fallback and diagnostics
items.limitations: Initial raw numeric policy only; Linux cgroup v2/host/process probes and portable caller override. Other OS/cgroup v1 use conservative fallback. Budgets exclude existing catalog, dependency overhead and caller-owned outputs; not a global RSS cap. String/style caches and concurrent strategies remain planned.
